proposals.action_title: Launch First Gothic & Cozy Cats Coloring Book on Amazon KDP
proposals.why_this_works_now: The 'cozy/gothic' niche is highly seasonal and trending on social media. Using Together AI (free FLUX-schnell) via GitHub Actions, Hugo can generate 40 clean black-and-white vector-style line arts, compile them using a free Python PDF library (ReportLab) in Termux, and publish with zero financial cost.
proposals.first_action_today: Run a bash script in Termux to call the Together AI API and generate 5 test coloring pages of 'Cozy Cat in a Witch Kitchen' with high-contrast line art settings.

proposals.action_title: Upload 50 Dark Academia & Goblincore Seamless Patterns
proposals.why_this_works_now: Redbubble requires no upfront fees and organic search traffic indexation happens within days. Seamless patterns generated via FLUX on Together AI can be tiled automatically. Dark Academia and Goblincore motifs have high search volume and low barrier to entry on apparel, phone cases, and notebooks.
proposals.first_action_today: Set up a GitHub Actions workflow that loops 50 times to generate seamless tiling patterns using FLUX-schnell with prompt modifiers like 'seamless vector pattern, vintage dark academia botany'.

proposals.action_title: Publish Parametric Drawer Organizer & Cable Clips
proposals.why_this_works_now: Functional 3D prints sell consistently because they solve immediate problems. OpenSCAD scripts can easily be run via Termux to output customizable .STL files. Offering a parametric file where buyers can change dimensions attracts makers willing to pay 1.50€ to 3.00€ to save design time.
proposals.first_action_today: Write a basic OpenSCAD script for a grid-based customizable drawer divider and render 5 standard size variations (.STL) directly in Termux.

proposals.action_title: Create a Premium Hardcover Version of the KDP Coloring Book
proposals.why_this_works_now: Hardcover books on KDP have a much higher perceived value and are frequently purchased as gifts. By using the exact same interior PDF as the paperback version and adjusting only the cover template size, Hugo can list a premium version priced at 14.99€ yielding a higher margin (4€+ per sale).
proposals.first_action_today: Use the KDP Cover Calculator to generate the exact PDF template dimensions for a 40-page hardcover book.

proposals.action_title: Launch a Niche 'Sourdough Baking Logbook' & '3D Printing Log'
proposals.why_this_works_now: Low-content logbooks are easy to generate programmatically. A python script using ReportLab can generate standard grid/log tables in seconds. Sourdough bakers and 3D printing enthusiasts are passionate hobbyists who love tracking variables (temperature, hydration, infill, speed) in physical books.
proposals.first_action_today: Create a Python script on GitHub/Termux to output a clean, minimalist 120-page interior PDF containing tracking tables for 3D printing filament logs.

proposals.action_title: Cross-Sell KDP Coloring Pages as Digital RPG Icons on Itch.io
proposals.why_this_works_now: Repurposing assets is key to high ROI per hour. The same prompt pipeline used for gothic/fantasy coloring pages can generate 2D asset packs (e.g., '50 Line Art Fantasy Weapon Icons'). Game developers on itch.io buy these cheap packs ($2-$5) to use as UI elements or coloring templates.
proposals.first_action_today: Zip 50 of the generated fantasy line-art icons, write a simple markdown description, and create a free creator account on itch.io.
